{{Quote|Do we really want to get exiled to a moon named Captivity? It doesn't sound like a lot of fun to me.|A Rebel soldier|<ref name="TFtF" />}}
The '''Grehollo system''' was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Manoe sector/Legends|Manoe sector]]. It contained the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base known as the [[Grehollo station]] as well as the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]]. The harsh conditions on Captivity allowed the Empire to use it to [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], with [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] from the Grehollo station patrolling the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] moon.

The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out a [[Mission to Captivity|mission]] to the Grehollo [[Star system/Legends|system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A team of Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] infiltrated the moon as exiles and located there a group of [[Politics/Legends|political]] prisoners important to the Alliance's cause. The [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] then transported both groups off Captivity and out of the Grehollo system.

==Description==
{{Quote|Then we probably have to climb through a raging storm to get them up to the top of a mountain. It figures that's the only spot on Captivity where a ship ''might'' be able to land.|A Rebel soldier, on the prisoners of Captivity|<ref name="TFtF" />}}
The Grehollo system was located in the [[Manoe sector/Legends|Manoe sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The Grehollo [[Star system/Legends|system]] contained the small terrestrial [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Captivity]] as well as the [[Grehollo station]], a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] base of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Captivity was covered in a layer of [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] and had frequent and violent storms, and its surface featured high [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and jagged rock formations. The hostile conditions of Captivity made landing a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] there highly dangerous.<ref name="TFtF" />

==History==
{{RPG|"[[To Free the Forgotten]]"}}
{{Quote|The real Rajah is safe, and we're here to get captured in his place.''"<br />"''We want to be exiled, not just captured.|Two of the Rebel soldiers on Virujansi|<ref name="TFtF" />}}
The Galactic Empire used Captivity to [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] who, for various reasons, had to be kept alive. The prisoners were dropped to the moon's surface in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], and Imperial [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]] from the Grehollo station frequently patrolled the moon.<ref name="TFtF" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] carried out a [[Mission to Captivity|mission]] to rescue [[Politics/Legends|political]] prisoners on Captivity who were important to the Alliance's cause, such as exiled [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial senators]]. A team of Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], posing as the [[Royal Court|leadership]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]],<ref name="TFtF" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Virujansi">{{CSWECite|III|308|Virujansi}}</ref> recently [[Takeover of Virujansi|taken over]] by the Empire, convinced Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Lariss]], the [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader]] of the Imperial force on Virujansi, to exile them to Captivity. After arriving on the moon, the soldiers located the prisoners, and both groups were eventually extracted by the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], which transported them out of the system.<ref name="TFtF" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|We may have to live here for the rest of our lives. Anything I leave behind, I risk giving to Rolo and his scum.|Captain Dedelin|<ref name="TFtF" />}}
The moon Captivity was inhabited by several groups of prisoners, some of them [[Human/Legends|Human]]. Eventually, the [[Rolo's Ruffians|gang]] of criminals led by [[Andews Rolo]] exterminated all other groups, with the exception of a smaller group of political prisoners led by former [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dedelin]].<ref name="TFtF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grehollo system appeared in "[[To Free the Forgotten]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure published in the [[1989]] ''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The adventure was written by [[Greg Gorden]], who developed it from a story by [[Steve Gilbert]] and [[Michael Stern]]. In "To Free the Forgotten," the players acting as game-masters are encouraged to improvise the conditions of the Rebel escape from the Grehollo system. This article assumes the adventure plays out as described.<ref name="TFtF" />

[[File:Grehollo-Voyages13.png|thumb|right|250px|Map from ''Voyages SF'' 13 depicting the Grehollo system as part of the sector of the same name]]
"[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] roleplaying game source article published in [[Voyages SF 13|''Voyages SF'' 13]], placed the Grehollo system in a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Grehollo sector|same name]]. According to the article, the system also contained a [[Unidentified prison planet|prison planet]]. Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it is considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref>

The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Grehollo system, and therefore Captivity, in grid square K-7.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that the [[Manoe system/Legends|Manoe system]] was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that every sector listed in the Online Companion would have at least one corresponding system,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163#post-31618818}}</ref> although Grehollo was also placed in the Manoe sector.<ref name="EAOC" />
